origin: Constructed independent functional requests, not corpus-derived or population gold

cases.topic: Planning a neighbourhood book swap. Write about 90 words with two speakers. Use each exact phrase once in the clean dialogue: two books; make a decision; a book swap; help with the event. Keep these sentences short and ordinary. For the separate mutation phase only, change two books to two book and make a decision to do a decision, once each. Do not change a book swap or help with the event. The clean dialogue must contain only correct English; the two deliberately incorrect replacements belong only in the later mutated dialogue.

Planning a neighbourhood book swap. Write about 90 words with two speakers. Use each exact phrase once: two books; make a decision; a book swap; help with the event. All of these are correct English. No mistakes are requested; preserve the complete clean dialogue unchanged in the mutation phase.

selection_rule: An alternative is functionally qualified only if both requests complete through native admission and the independent literal semantic expectations hold. Do not select by schema success alone. Preserve all failures; any subsequent demonstrated repair is a separately recorded variant with its invalidated cases.

quality.TP: Expected erroneous target identified with the requested category and valid preferred correction
quality.FP: Claimed error outside the two declared targets or on a correct control
quality.FN: Declared expected target not correctly produced and keyed
quality.TN: Declared correct control preserved without an error unit
quality.failure: Unavailable output remains failed with coverage recorded; do not count it as a zero-error success or assign unobserved semantic rates

cost.latency: Actual sequential wall time, including cold load where applicable; n=2 functional requests per alternative, no population statistics
cost.tokens: Actual returned usage; missing remains null

proof_limit: Instruction-following functional repair on four fixed requests. No arbitrary 122-category generation, answer-checking model, speech or population accuracy qualification. Normal product use has no Lab/benchmark prerequisite.
variant: same installed GPT-OSS and scope prompt, with single-admission mechanical weight/rationale projection repair
rationale: The actual reply contained both requested mistakes, valid preferred repairs and display rationales, but omitted redundant fixed weights and copied optional learner-explanation flags. Normalize those mechanical product-owned fields once from already supplied information; preserve malformed explicit values and all raw replies. Reobserve the same fixed requests through native owners. No additional model or prompt variant is selected.
